notes: Sourced from d&b audiotechnik's official D80 product page technical-data table (manufacturer's own site, fetched directly — no separate PDF datasheet link was surfaced by the fetch, but the page's own spec table is complete and internally consistent across repeated fetches). Confirmed rear-panel layout: 4x analog XLR3 inputs (A1-A4) each with an analog XLR3 Link output for daisy-chaining, 2x AES3 digital input pairs (D1/2, D3/4) with one shared AES3 Digital Link output, 4x NL4 (4-pole Speakon) per-channel speaker outputs plus 1x NL8 (8-pole Speakon) combined output for all 4 channels, 2x RJ45 CAN-Bus ports (parallel, no stated data-rate so left ungraded), 2x etherCON ports for 10/100 Mbit Ethernet (graded eth-100m, the higher of the two supported speeds), and a powerCON-HC mains inlet (mapped to the generic "powercon" id since the taxonomy has no HC-current variant). Format is 2 RU x 19"/530 mm, weight ~19 kg/42 lb, no GPIO/USB ports found on the rear panel per the manufacturer page. Power output rated 4x 2600 W (2/4Ω) or 4x 4000 W depending on load/voltage settings.
